localised_description: The Tablets want the tolls of that place counted in our column. Take it standing.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.

localised_description: A general is being spoken of with respect. Correct that.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.

localised_description: Everything in that place that was forged can be forged again, here. Bring it back in pieces.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.

localised_description: The Khanate does not care how it is done, only that the name stops being used.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.

localised_description: Take it whole. Ashes cannot be put to work, and the Overseers are counting hands.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.

localised_description: Empty it. The column that leaves is the payment, and it is measured in bodies.
localised_mission_completed_text: The guild has been paid in full, and so have you.
